label: Point forecast plan
method: Synthetic planning inputs: an 80-session point forecast and a 100-session upper estimate, with 10 sessions per tutor allocation. These require eight and 10 allocations, respectively, a difference of 20 sessions of capacity. Coverage of the upper estimate and economic value require separate validation.
